newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets third round of specials.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets third round of specials.

text.p: The Bank of Canada conducted a third round of special purchase and resale agreements at 3.5 percent on Monday, confirming its target ceiling for Canada's call loan rate, traders said.
The central bank intervened to add liquidity to the money market after the call loan rate was trading at the high end of its 3.0-3.5 percent range.
One trader said that the central bank set a third round of specials despite the early closing of Toronto's bond trading at 1200 EDT/1600 GMT ahead of the Canada Day holiday on Tuesday.
"Somebody must be still looking," he said, although call loan had not traded since early afternoon today.
